title: Jacobikerk at Le Guess Who?
role: Light design, immersive projection & live operation
excerpt: Turning the historic Jacobikerk into an immersive projected space for Le Guess Who? 2022.
description:
For Le Guess Who? 2022 I turned the historic Jacobikerk in Utrecht into an immersive projected space for the festival's concert programme, the setting for performances by Mabe Fratti, Hatis Noit, Hinako Omori, Max Cooper and Sote & Tarik Barri.
> Working with the church's gothic architecture, light wrapped the nave and its chandeliers in slow, shifting colour, turning the building itself into an instrument of atmosphere. Through the concerts I played light and image live, letting the space breathe with each performance.
credits: Light design & projection: Jaco Schilp, with Skander Jaïbi and Cris Molle. Presented with Uncloud at Le Guess Who? 2022, Jacobikerk, Utrecht. Photography: Paulus van Dorsten.
